name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-inbox
description: Establishes a new repository as a runnable workspace application: a plain Vite + React app on @gears-frontx/ui-kit with dashboard, chat inbox, mail and contacts screens, its own hash router and UI strings, mocked @gears-frontx/api services, and the build, lint and test toolchain in place. Apply this to start a helpdesk, shared mailbox, contacts or metrics product; it needs no other template. It does not use the FrontX runtime (no @gears-frontx/react, no microfrontends) and is not a shell variant.
